caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.gamma.tooltip: Post-transform luminance gamma. Values below 1.00 brighten shadows and midtones while preserving black, white, and color ratios.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum number of secondary path-tracing bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.fog.tooltip: Primary-view hybrid fog with sharp, TLAS-shadowed sun and moon shafts plus soft temporally accumulated GI haze.
caustica.options.rt.fogQuality.tooltip: Controls the camera-froxel grid. Finer settings reduce direct-light stair-stepping and improve shaft detail at higher GPU cost.
caustica.options.rt.fogDistance.tooltip: Maximum distance integrated by the camera-view fog volume.
caustica.options.rt.fogDirectSamples.too: Supersamples sun and moon visibility inside each froxel. Higher settings smooth shaft edges at higher GPU cost.
caustica.options.rt.fogLocalSamples.tool: Samples local emissive area lights independently from GI. Higher settings reduce direct-light shimmer and noise at higher GPU cost.
caustica.options.rt.fogGiSamples.tooltip: Ray samples used for the soft indirect fog field. Higher settings reduce temporal noise at higher GPU cost.
caustica.options.rt.fogGiSoftness.toolti: Spatial radius used to smooth the indirect fog history. Higher settings make GI haze softer and less grainy.
caustica.options.rt.fogGiHistory.tooltip: Temporal accumulation for indirect fog. Lower settings respond faster to camera movement; higher settings reduce steady-state noise.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Recreate the swapchain for HDR (ST.2084/PQ) or native SDR output. Applied at the next frame boundary.
caustica.options.rt.hdrUiBrightness.tool: Absolute brightness (in nits) assigned to SDR-authored UI on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Inspect ray-tracing buffers and exposure diagnostics after the normal frame has rendered.
